House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Public Safety Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to public safety; appropriating money for ongoing maintenance for digital geographic information system mapping for school facilities.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+DIGITAL GEOGRAPHIC INFORMATION SYSTEM MAPPING FOR SCHOOL FACILITIES; APPROPRIATION. +]

[+$1,102,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of public safety for grants to the regional emergency communications boards, as defined in Minnesota Statutes, section 403.392, for ongoing maintenance of the statewide digital geographic information system mapping of school facilities project under Laws 2024, chapter 123, article 1, section 18. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until expended. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to public safety; appropriating money for ongoing maintenance for digital geographic information system mapping for school facilities.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. DIGITAL GEOGRAPHIC INFORMATION SYSTEM MAPPING FOR SCHOOL FACILITIES; APPROPRIATION.

$1,102,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of public safety for grants to the regional emergency communications boards, as defined in Minnesota Statutes, section 403.392, for ongoing maintenance of the statewide digital geographic information system mapping of school facilities project under Laws 2024, chapter 123, article 1, section 18. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until expended.
